lines: Review fixes for V3 (review of 7d5ab01c: land, 0 blocking, 2 medium, 3 low) on track/v-admin-cleanup, head 50a55b04.

86dc46b5 fixup! feat(admin-cleanup) (squashes into 1b2696af): (1) RecordingCategoryPanel one-time cell: 'Linked to a SIP month' only when sipScheduleId or sipMonth is set, 'One-time' when category is one_time, otherwise 'Cannot be categorised'; (3) proposedAmountOf returns null for a ref missing from the proposal, and the form leaves that field empty, so the sum gate blocks Confirm and the line reads 'Enter an amount for every investment'; adds splitFormKeyOf (fund id, cutoff entry id, every investment ref key).

50a55b04 fixup! fix(admin-cleanup) (squashes into 7d5ab01c): (2) EarlierGrowthPanel keys each fund form by splitFormKeyOf, so a refetch that adds or removes an investment under the same cutoff re-seeds the fields. Split this way because one fixup on 1b2696af conflicted with 7d5ab01c's import block.

Reload to see the new total.' with Reload; says no email is sent; market-risk footnote.
